parts:

I can only view one when I move the slider to one instead of 4. I only got 95PPU for the first observed data using a behavioural threshold of 0.5 NSE value. 
Please can you kindly help me solve this issue? 
Any suggestion or help would be immensely appreciated.

Thank you
